mapper.select: select cast(c.id as varchar) collection_id, c.collection_code, cast(r.id as varchar) revision_id, r.revision_no, r.collection_name, r.collection_type, cast(r.certification_id as varchar) certification_id, ec.certification_name, cast(r.syllabus_version_id as varchar) syllabus_version_id, sv.version_name syllabus_version_name, r.status, (cur.collection_revision_id=r.id) current_published, (r.status='rejected' and nullif(btrim(r.review_opinion),'') is not null) has_review_opinion, r.row_version, r.question_count, r.total_report_score, r.duration_minutes, r.update_time updated_time from cm_collection c join cm_collection_revision r on r.collection_id=c.id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=r.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=r.syllabus_version_id left join cm_collection_current cur on cur.collection_id=c.id where order by case when r.status='rejected' then 0 when r.status='published' and cur.collection_revision_id=r.id then 1 when r.status='pending_review' then 2 else 3 end, r.revision_no desc, r.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from cm_collection c join cm_collection_revision r on r.collection_id=c.id where

select c.id from cm_collection c join cm_collection_revision r on r.collection_id=c.id where group by c.id order by min(case when r.status='rejected' then 0 when r.status='published' then 1 when r.status='pending_review' then 2 else 3 end), greatest(max(c.update_time), max(r.update_time)) desc, c.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(distinct c.id) from cm_collection c join cm_collection_revision r on r.collection_id=c.id where

select cast(c.id as varchar) collection_id, c.collection_code, c.collection_name parent_collection_name, c.update_time collection_updated_time, cast(r.id as varchar) revision_id, r.revision_no, r.collection_name, r.collection_type, cast(r.certification_id as varchar) certification_id, ec.certification_name, cast(r.syllabus_version_id as varchar) syllabus_version_id, sv.version_name syllabus_version_name, r.status, (cur.collection_revision_id=r.id) current_published, (r.status='rejected' and nullif(btrim(r.review_opinion),'') is not null) has_review_opinion, r.row_version, r.question_count, r.total_report_score, r.duration_minutes, r.update_time updated_time from cm_collection c join cm_collection_revision r on r.collection_id=c.id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=r.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=r.syllabus_version_id left join cm_collection_current cur on cur.collection_id=c.id where c.id in #{collectionId} order by array_position(array[#{collectionId}]::bigint[], c.id), case when r.status='rejected' then 0 when r.status='published' then 1 when r.status='pending_review' then 2 else 3 end, r.revision_no desc, r.id desc
mapper.sql: r.id, r.collection_id, c.collection_code, r.revision_no, r.status, r.row_version, r.collection_name, r.collection_type, r.certification_id, ec.certification_name, r.syllabus_version_id, sv.version_name syllabus_version_name, r.question_count, r.total_report_score, r.duration_minutes, r.pause_allowed, r.review_opinion, r.update_time updated_time
mapper.select: select from cm_collection_revision r join cm_collection c on c.id=r.collection_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=r.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=r.syllabus_version_id where r.id=#{revisionId} for update of r

select from cm_collection_revision r join cm_collection c on c.id=r.collection_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=r.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=r.syllabus_version_id left join cm_collection_current cur on cur.collection_id=r.collection_id where r.collection_id=#{collectionId} order by case when r.status in ('draft','pending_review','rejected') then 0 when r.id=cur.collection_revision_id then 1 else 2 end, r.revision_no desc limit 1

select from cm_collection_current cur join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=cur.collection_revision_id join cm_collection c on c.id=r.collection_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=r.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=r.syllabus_version_id where cur.collection_id=#{collectionId} and r.status='published'

select from cm_collection_revision r join cm_collection c on c.id=r.collection_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=r.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=r.syllabus_version_id where r.collection_id=#{collectionId} and r.status='pending_review' limit 1

select from cm_collection_current cur join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=cur.collection_revision_id join cm_collection c on c.id=r.collection_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=r.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=r.syllabus_version_id where cur.collection_id=#{collectionId} and r.status='published' for update of r

select from cm_collection_revision r join cm_collection c on c.id=r.collection_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=r.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=r.syllabus_version_id where r.collection_id=#{collectionId} and r.status='published' order by r.id for update of r

select from cm_collection_item i join cm_collection_revision r on r.id=i.collection_revision_id join cm_collection c on c.id=r.collection_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=r.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=r.syllabus_version_id where i.question_revision_id=#{questionRevisionId} and r.status='pending_review' order by r.id for update of r

select from cm_collection_revision r join cm_collection c on c.id=r.collection_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=r.certification_id join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=r.syllabus_version_id where r.collection_id=#{collectionId} order by r.revision_no desc
mapper.sql: i.item_order, i.question_revision_id, qr.question_id, q.question_code, qr.stem, qr.question_type, qr.difficulty, qr.status, q.exam_subject_id, es.subject_name exam_subject_name, kp.id knowledge_point_id, concat(kp.syllabus_number,' ',kp.syllabus_title) knowledge_point_label, i.report_score, cast(i.answer_schema as text) answer_schema, qr.estimated_seconds, es.certification_id, kp.syllabus_version_id, (select count(*) from cm_question_knowledge qk left join cm_knowledge_point qkp on qkp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and (qkp.id is null or qkp.del_flag<>'0' or exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id=qkp.id and child.del_flag='0'))) invalid_knowledge_count ,(select count(*) from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point qkp on qkp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and qkp.del_flag='0' and not exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id=qkp.id and child.del_flag='0') and (qkp.importance is null or qkp.importance not in (1,2,3))) missing_leaf_importance_count
mapper.select: select from cm_collection_item i join cm_question_revision qr on qr.id=i.question_revision_id join cm_question q on q.id=qr.question_id join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=q.exam_subject_id left join lateral (select kp.* from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id order by case qk.relation_role when 'primary' then 0 else 1 end, qk.sort_order limit 1) kp on true where i.collection_revision_id=#{revisionId} order by i.item_order

select 0 item_order, qr.id question_revision_id, qr.question_id, q.question_code, qr.stem, qr.question_type, qr.difficulty, qr.status, q.exam_subject_id, es.subject_name exam_subject_name, kp.id knowledge_point_id, concat(kp.syllabus_number,' ',kp.syllabus_title) knowledge_point_label, cast(qr.answer as text) answer_schema, qr.estimated_seconds, es.certification_id, kp.syllabus_version_id, (select count(*) from cm_question_knowledge qk left join cm_knowledge_point qkp on qkp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and (qkp.id is null or qkp.del_flag<>'0' or exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id=qkp.id and child.del_flag='0'))) invalid_knowledge_count ,(select count(*) from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point qkp on qkp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and qkp.del_flag='0' and not exists (select 1 from cm_knowledge_point child where child.parent_id=qkp.id and child.del_flag='0') and qkp.importance not in (1,2,3)) missing_leaf_importance_count from cm_question_revision qr join cm_question q on q.id=qr.question_id join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=q.exam_subject_id left join lateral (select kp.* from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id order by case qk.relation_role when 'primary' then 0 else 1 end, qk.sort_order limit 1) kp on true where qr.id in #{id} and q.del_flag='0' and q.create_by=#{visibleUserId}
select id from cm_collection where id=#{collectionId} for update
select id from cm_collection_revision where collection_id=#{collectionId} and status='draft' order by revision_no desc, id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update cm_collection set collection_name=#{name},update_time=now() where id=#{collectionId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_exam_certification where id=#{certificationId}
select count(*) from cm_syllabus_version where id=#{syllabusId} and certification_id=#{certificationId}
select id from cm_exam_subject where certification_id=#{certificationId} order by id
select coalesce(max(revision_no),0)+1 from cm_collection_revision where collection_id=#{collectionId}
mapper.update: update cm_collection set exam_year=#{examYear},exam_month=#{examMonth},paper_type_code=#{paperTypeCode},paper_type_name=#{paperTypeName},update_time=now() where id=#{collectionId} and collection_type=#{type}

update cm_collection_revision set collection_name=#{name},collection_type=#{type},certification_id=#{certificationId},syllabus_version_id=#{syllabusVersionId},duration_minutes=#{durationMinutes},question_count=#{questionCount},total_report_score=#{totalScore},row_version=row_version+1,update_time=now() where id=#{revisionId} and status in ('draft','rejected') and row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.delete: delete from cm_collection_revision where id=#{revisionId} and status in ('draft','rejected')
mapper.select: select count(*) from cm_collection_revision where collection_id=#{collectionId}
mapper.update: update cm_collection_revision set status='pending_review',submitted_by=#{userId},submitted_time=now(),review_opinion=null,row_version=row_version+1,update_time=now() where id=#{revisionId} and status in ('draft','rejected')

update cm_collection_revision set status='rejected',reviewed_by=#{userId},reviewed_time=now(),review_opinion=#{opinion},row_version=row_version+1,update_time=now() where id=#{revisionId} and status='pending_review'

update cm_collection_revision set status='published',reviewed_by=#{userId},reviewed_time=now(),published_by=#{userId},published_time=now(),review_opinion=null,row_version=row_version+1,update_time=now() where id=#{revisionId} and status='pending_review'
update cm_collection_revision set status='draft',row_version=row_version+1,update_time=now() where id=#{revisionId} and status='published'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_collection_current(collection_id,collection_revision_id,purpose_code,effective_time,update_time) values(#{collectionId},#{revisionId},'LEARNING',now(),now()) on conflict(collection_id) do update set collection_revision_id=excluded.collection_revision_id,effective_time=excluded.effective_time,update_time=now()
mapper.delete: delete from cm_collection_current where collection_id=#{collectionId} and collection_revision_id=#{revisionId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_business_audit_log(id,operator_id,domain_code,action_code,target_type,target_id,before_data,after_data,trace_id) values(#{id},#{operatorId},'question',#{action},'collection_revision',#{revisionId},cast(#{beforeData} as jsonb),cast(#{afterData} as jsonb),#{traceId})
mapper.select: select id,payload_hash,status,resource_id,cast(response_body as text) response_body from cm_idempotency_record where action_code=#{action} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_idempotency_record(id,action_code,request_id,payload_hash,status,resource_type,resource_id,expires_time) values(#{id},#{action},#{requestId},#{payloadHash},'processing','collection',#{resourceId},#{expiresTime}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update cm_idempotency_record set status='succeeded',resource_id=#{resourceId},response_status=#{responseStatus},response_body=cast(#{responseBody} as jsonb),update_time=now() where id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_business_audit_log(id,operator_id,domain_code,action_code,target_type,target_id,before_data,after_data,trace_id) values(#{id},#{userId},'collection',#{action},'collection_revision',#{revisionId},cast(#{beforeData} as jsonb),cast(#{afterData} as jsonb),#{traceId})
